Control label layout in gratia plots

Source: R/draw-label-control.R
draw_label_control.Rd

Configure labels on axes, legends and colour bars across draw() and assemble() methods. Omitted settings retain the existing appearance.

Usage

draw_label_control(axes = list(), legend = list(), colourbar = list())

Arguments

axes

Named list with optional wrap, n_dodge, angle and title_wrap settings. wrap and title_wrap are positive integer widths in characters. Tick labels wrap at word boundaries, preserving explicit line breaks. Unbroken words are not split. n_dodge is the positive integer number of rows for horizontal-axis labels, or columns for vertical-axis labels. angle is a finite number of degrees between -90 and 90. Tick settings apply only to discrete axes; title_wrap applies to ordinary x and y axis titles, including continuous axes.

legend

Named list with optional wrap, title_wrap, nrow, ncol and byrow settings. Wrapping widths and row/column counts are positive integers. byrow is logical. These settings apply to key-based legends, including colour, fill, shape and linetype legends.

colourbar

Named list with optional title_wrap, angle, width and height settings. title_wrap is a positive integer width in characters; angle is between -90 and 90 degrees. Dimensions are positive, length-one grid::unit() objects and refer to the displayed bar's width and height. These settings apply to continuous colour and fill guides.

Value

A draw_label_control object.

Details

Every setting defaults to NULL, retaining the method's existing behaviour. Pass the result as label_control to draw() or assemble(). The same configuration can be reused across plot types; absent guides are ignored. Mathematical expressions and missing labels are preserved. Wrapping changes displayed text after scale labelling, without changing factor levels, breaks, transformations or palettes. Numeric formatting remains controlled by the scale's labels argument.

Explicit axis settings override the existing angle and n_dodge plotting arguments on discrete axes. Hidden guides stay hidden. Native guide types and unrelated settings are retained; later ggplot2 scale and guide additions follow their usual precedence. Settings apply to panels before patchwork collects their guides, including plots returned with wrap = FALSE. Projected coordinate labels in 3D plots retain their renderer's settings; their ordinary legends and colour bars can use this control.

See also

draw(), assemble(), gratia_theme_get()

Examples

# Wrap categorical tick labels and stagger them across two rows.
layout <- draw_label_control(axes = list(wrap = 12, n_dodge = 2))

# Reuse one configuration for legend text and colour-bar layout.
layout <- draw_label_control(
  axes = list(wrap = 12),
  legend = list(wrap = 20, title_wrap = 20, ncol = 2),
  colourbar = list(title_wrap = 20, height = grid::unit(35, "mm"))
)

# Draw a model with the requested layout.
load_mgcv()
dat <- data_sim("eg4", n = 100, seed = 42)
model <- gam(y ~ fac + s(x2, by = fac, k = 5), data = dat, method = "REML")
draw(model, label_control = layout)
